# laravelforge_org_team_invite (Data Source)

Fetches a single pending Laravel Forge team invitation by ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the invitation.
- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `team_id` (Number) ID of the team.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `email` (String) Email address of the invited member.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
